note_title: 对含参数方程根的估计

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#1
callouts.title: 问题0
callouts.body: 设$\cos(x)=sx$的$N(s)$个正根按照顺序排列为$$x_1<x_2<\cdots<x_{N(s)}$$证明$$\lim_{s\to 0^{+}}\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)-1}\frac{1}{x_kx_{k+1}}=\frac{2}{\pi^2}$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#1

if_problem.statement_en:
Let the \(N(s)\) positive roots of \(\cos(x)=sx\) be ordered as
\\[
x_1<x_2<\\cdots<x_{N(s)}.
\\]
Prove that
\\[
\\lim_{s\	o 0^{+}}\\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)-1}\\frac{1}{x_kx_{k+1}}=\\frac{2}{\\pi^2}.
\\]
key_techniques: asymptotic estimation of roots of parameter-dependent equations

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#2
callouts.title: 想法1.1.1
callouts.body:
对于这种和的估计，我们最直接的想法是做“逐项估计”。如果我们可以得到$\frac{1}{x_kx_{k+1}}$的一个足够精确又足够好的渐近展开，那么我们只需要求和就可以得到想要的结果。具体来说，如果我们可以得到$$\frac{1}{x_kx_{k+1}}=a_k(s) +r_k(s)$$然后满足:
1. $\sum_k a_k(s)$的和是已知的，容易的。
2. $\sum_k r_k(s)=o(1)$,此处$o(1)$表示一个关于$s$的无穷小量。

如果以上两个条件都可以被满足，那么问题就解决了。

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#2

if_strategy_template.summary_en: Decompose each summand into a main term and an error term, \(\\frac{1}{x_kx_{k+1}}=a_k(s)+r_k(s)\). If the main terms can be summed explicitly and the total error is \(o(1)\), then the whole sum is determined.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when estimating parameter-dependent finite or infinite sums whose individual terms admit sufficiently uniform asymptotic expansions.

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#3
callouts.title: lemma 1.2.1
callouts.body:
设$\cos(x)=sx$的$N(s)$个正根按照顺序排列为$$x_1(s)<x_2(s)<\cdots<x_{N(s)}(s)$$那么:
1. $N(s)\sim \frac{1}{\pi s}$
2. 对于$1\leq k\leq N(s)$都有$$k\pi<x_k(s)<(k+1)\pi$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#3

if_problem.statement_en:
Let the \(N(s)\) positive roots of \(\cos(x)=sx\) be ordered as
\\[
x_1(s)<x_2(s)<\\cdots<x_{N(s)}(s).
\\]
Then:
1. \(N(s)\\sim \\frac{1}{\\pi s}\).
2. For every \(1\\leq k\\leq N(s)\),
\\[
k\\pi<x_k(s)<(k+1)\\pi.
\\]
key_techniques: monotonicity and sign changes of trigonometric functions

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#4
callouts.title: 想法1.3.1
callouts.body:
我们是否可以寻找一个$q(s)$，其满足：
1. 当$1\leq k< q(s)$的时候$|\sin(x_k(t))|>c>0$。
2. 而后半段的和$\sum_{N(s)-1\geq k\geq q(s)}\frac{1}{x_k(s)x_{k+1}(s)}$只要用"引理1.2.1"当中的估计就可以得到$o(1)$的估计？

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#4

if_strategy_template.summary_en: Choose a cutoff \(q(s)\) so that on the initial segment the roots stay in a regime with good lower bounds, while the tail can be estimated crudely using general bounds. This reduces the problem to a precise estimate on the main range plus an \(o(1)\) tail.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a sum over roots has different behavior in a low-index region and a high-index region, and the tail can be controlled by coarse asymptotic bounds.

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#5
callouts.title: 定理2.1:一般的控制收敛定理
callouts.body: $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mu)$是一个测度空间，$\{f_{\alpha}\}_{\alpha \in A}$是一个可测函数族，并且存在一个可积函数$g\geq 0$使得$$|f_{\alpha}|\leq g ,\forall \alpha \in A$$那么如果$f_{\alpha}$几乎处处收敛到$f$，那么$$\int_{\Omega}f_{\alpha}\,d\mu\to \int_{\Omega}f\,d\mu$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#5

if_problem.statement_en:
Let \((\\Omega,\\mathcal{F},\\mu)\) be a measure space, and let \\(\\{f_{\\alpha}\\}_{\\alpha\\in A}\\) be a family of measurable functions. Suppose there exists an integrable function \(g\\ge 0\) such that
\\[
|f_{\\alpha}|\\le g,\\quad \\forall \\alpha\\in A.
\\]
If \(f_{\\alpha}\	o f\) almost everywhere, then
\\[
\\int_{\\Omega} f_{\\alpha}\\,d\\mu \	o \\int_{\\Omega} f\\,d\\mu.
\\]

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#6
callouts.title: 定理2.2：Tannery定理
callouts.body:
$\{a_{s,k}\}_{s\in S}$是一族序列，满足：
1. 对任意正整数$k\geq 1$都有$a_{s,k}\to a_k$。
2. 存在一个与$s$无关的非负序列$M_k$使得对任意的$k$都有$|a_{s,k}|\leq M_k$并且$\sum_{k\geq 1}M_k<\infty$

那么$$\sum_{k\geq 1} a_{s,k}\to \sum_{k\geq 1}a_k$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#6

if_problem.statement_en:
Let \\(\\{a_{s,k}\\}_{s\\in S}\\) be a family of sequences such that:
1. For every positive integer \(k\\ge 1\), \(a_{s,k}\	o a_k\).
2. There exists a nonnegative sequence \(M_k\), independent of \(s\), such that for every \(k\), \( |a_{s,k}|\\le M_k \), and
\\[
\\sum_{k\\ge 1} M_k<\\infty.
\\]
Then
\\[
\\sum_{k\\ge 1} a_{s,k}\	o \\sum_{k\\ge 1} a_k.
\\]

callouts.title: 问题3.1
callouts.body: 设$\cos(x)=sx$的$N(s)$个正根按照顺序排列为$$x_1<x_2<\cdots<x_{N(s)}$$证明$$\lim_{s\to 0^{+}}s^2\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)}\frac{1}{(x_k-(k-1/2)\pi)^2}=\frac{1}{2}$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#7

if_problem.statement_en:
Let the \(N(s)\) positive roots of \(\cos(x)=sx\) be ordered as
\\[
x_1<x_2<\\cdots<x_{N(s)}.
\\]
Prove that
\\[
\\lim_{s\	o 0^{+}}s^2\\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)}\\frac{1}{(x_k-(k-1/2)\\pi)^2}=\\frac{1}{2}.
\\]

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#8
callouts.title: 命题3.2
callouts.body: 设$F(s,x):\mathbb{R}^2\to \mathbb{R}$在$(s^{*},x_k(0))$的某个邻域$U$内满足$$F\in C^p(U\to \mathbb{R}),F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\neq 0$$那么存在且唯一一个$s^{*}$的邻域$V$以及$x_k(0)$的邻域$W$使得$$F(s,x(s))=0\forall s\in V,x(s)\in C^p(V\to W)$$并且有渐近展开$$x(s)=x(s^{*})+\sum_{i=1}^p \frac{x^{(p)}(s)}{i!}(s-s^{*})^i+o(|s-s^{*}|^p)$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#8

if_problem.statement_en:
Let \(F(s,x):\\mathbb{R}^2\	o\\mathbb{R}\) satisfy
\\[
F\\in C^p(U\	o\\mathbb{R}),\\quad F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,\\quad F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\
eq 0
\\]
in some neighborhood \(U\) of \((s^{*},x_k(0))\). Then there exist a unique neighborhood \(V\) of \(s^{*}\) and a neighborhood \(W\) of \(x_k(0)\) such that
\\[
F(s,x(s))=0\\quad \\forall s\\in V,\\qquad x(s)\\in C^p(V\	o W),
\\]
and \(x(s)\) has the asymptotic expansion
\\[
x(s)=x(s^{*})+\\sum_{i=1}^p \\frac{x^{(i)}(s^{*})}{i!}(s-s^{*})^i+o(|s-s^{*}|^p).
\\]

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#9
callouts.title: 命题3.3
callouts.body: 设$F(s,x):\mathbb{R}^2\to \mathbb{R}$在$(s^{*},x_k(0))$的某个邻域$U$内满足$F$是一个实数解析函数并且$$F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\neq 0$$那么存在一个$s^{*}$的邻域$V$以及$x_k(0)$的邻域$W$使得在$V$上方程$F(s,x)=0$有且仅有一个解分支：$$x(s):V\to W$$并且$x(s)$是一个实解析函数，即$$x(s)=\sum_{i\geq 0}a_i s^i,\forall s\in V$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#9

if_problem.statement_en:
Let \(F(s,x):\\mathbb{R}^2\	o\\mathbb{R}\) be real analytic in some neighborhood \(U\) of \((s^{*},x_k(0))\), and suppose
\\[
F(s^{*},x_k(0))=0,\\quad F_x(s^{*},x_k(0))\
eq 0.
\\]
Then there exist a neighborhood \(V\) of \(s^{*}\) and a neighborhood \(W\) of \(x_k(0)\) such that on \(V\) the equation \(F(s,x)=0\) has exactly one solution branch
\\[
x(s):V\	o W,
\\]
and \(x(s)\) is real analytic, namely
\\[
x(s)=\\sum_{i\\ge 0} a_i s^i,\\quad \\forall s\\in V.
\\]

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#10
callouts.title: 定理3.4(Lagrange inversion/Lagrange-Burmann formula)
callouts.body: $\phi(x)$在$x=r$的邻域中解析，且$\phi(r)\neq 0$。考虑方程$$x=r+s\phi(x)$$则在$s=0$的邻域中，方程存在唯一解析解$$x(s)=r+\sum_{i\geq 1}a_i s^i $$其中系数$$c_i = \frac{1}{i!}\lim_{x\to r } \frac{d^{i-1}}{d x^{i-1}}[(x-r)^i\phi(x)^i]$$

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#10

if_problem.statement_en:
Assume \(\\phi(x)\) is analytic in a neighborhood of \(x=r\), and \(\\phi(r)\
eq 0\). Consider the equation
\\[
x=r+s\\phi(x).
\\]
Then in a neighborhood of \(s=0\), the equation has a unique analytic solution
\\[
x(s)=r+\\sum_{i\\ge 1} c_i s^i,
\\]
where the coefficients are given by
\\[
c_i=\\frac{1}{i!}\\lim_{x\	o r}\\frac{d^{\,i-1}}{dx^{\,i-1}}\\big[(x-r)^i\\phi(x)^i\\big].
\\]

callouts.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#11
callouts.title: 想法3.5
callouts.body:
我们可以重新定义$$b_{s,k}:=\begin{cases}\frac{s^2}{(x_k(s)-x_k(0))^2}&1\leq k \leq N(s)^{2/3}\\ 0 &k>N(s)^{2/3}\end{cases}$$于是对于此时的$b_{s,k}$，它满足:
1. 对任意固定的$k$，由于$N(s)^{2/3}\to \infty$，所以$b_{s,k}\to \frac{1}{\pi^2}\frac{1}{(k-1/2)^2}$
2. 对任意的$k\leq N(s)^{2/3}$，$$b_{s,k}\leq \frac{1}{x_k'(\xi_{k,s})^2}\lesssim \frac{1}{(k+1)^2}$$后者可以组成一个非负的收敛级数。

于是Tannery定理告诉我们

$$\sum_{k\leq N(s)^{2/3}}\frac{1}{(x_k(s)-x_k(0))^2}=\sum_{k\geq 1}b_{s,k}\to \sum_{k\geq 1}\frac{1}{x_k'(0)^2}=\frac{1}{2}$$

然后从分段估计的角度入手，对于后半段，由于$$\frac{s^2}{(x_k(s)-x_k(0))^2}\leq \frac{s^2}{\pi^2}\frac{1}{(k-(-1)^k(k-1/2))^2}$$
当$k$是偶数的时候后者为$O(s^2)$，当$k$是奇数的时候后者为$O(s^2/k^2)$,于是无论$k$为奇数或者偶数，我们都可以用$O(s^2)$来控制$\frac{s^2}{\pi^2}\frac{1}{(k-(-1)^k(k-1/2))^2}$于是$$\sum_{N(s)\geq k>N(s)^{2/3}}\frac{s^2}{(x_k(s)-x_k(0))^2}=\sum_{N(s)\geq k>N(s)^{2/3}} O(s^2)=O(s)$$
所以分段估计是可以解决此处的困难的。

classification_result.id: 对含参数方程根的估计#11

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Truncate, apply Tannery, then bound the tail
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Define a truncated sequence that agrees with the original terms on an initial range and is zero afterward, so pointwise convergence and a summable dominating sequence allow Tannery's theorem to handle the main part. Then estimate the remaining tail separately by coarse bounds after splitting the index range.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies to parameter-dependent sums where direct domination fails globally but holds on a growing initial segment, while the complementary tail is small enough to be controlled by elementary estimates.
